settings.enumeration: all 3^n active-set patterns, numpy.linalg.solve (n <= 6); exact: fractions.Fraction

header.notes: Dimensionless QPs: minimize 0.5 x.H.x + g.x subject to lo <= x <= hi, H row-major flat SPD. Cases carry x_ref (exact, enumerated or SciPy: see x_ref_source), active_ref (-1 lower, 0 free, +1 upper) and the SciPy result for comparison.

all_active_n5.note: every variable ends at a bound

degenerate_zero_multiplier_n5.note: constructed: x_0 at lower and x_1 at upper bound with multiplier exactly 0 (to rounding of g), x_3, x_4 active with positive multipliers, x_2 free

start_at_bound_zero_gradient_n4.note: g = 0: the minimizer is x = 0, which sits at a bound for x_0, x_2 (lower) and x_3 (upper), all with multiplier 0

fixed_variable_n5.note: x_1 and x_3 fixed (lo == hi); their multipliers have either sign

cond1e8_n6.note: cond(H) = 1e8 (eigenvalues 1 to 1e8); reference by exact rational enumeration of all 729 patterns
